mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.name AS accountName, a.balance AS balance, a.paymeth AS payMethod, a.isdefault AS isDefault FROM db_erp.t_erp_fin_account a WHERE a.shopid = #{groupid} AND (a.isdelete = 0 OR a.isdelete IS NULL) ORDER BY a.isdefault DESC, a.createdate ASC

SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.formentryid AS entryId, p.payprice AS payPrice, p.acct AS accountId, a.name AS accountName, p.projectid AS projectId, fp.name AS projectName, p.remark AS remark, p.createdate AS createDate, p.opttime AS optTime, p.auditstatus AS auditStatus, p.payment_method AS paymentMethod FROM db_erp.t_erp_purchase_form_payment p LEFT JOIN db_erp.t_erp_fin_account a ON p.acct = a.id LEFT JOIN db_erp.t_erp_fin_project fp ON p.projectid = fp.id WHERE p.formentryid = #{entryId} ORDER BY p.createdate DESC
